[LUNI.13.5.3] `currency.round()` is the method form, distinct from the
generic `round(x)` builtin **function** ([LEXP.3.2]) which uses the
IEEE 754 `roundTiesToEven` default. The method `.round(...)` on any
receiver is treated as the currency form and gated; the function
`round(x)` is the Float-default form and ungated. The parser
discriminates by MethodCall vs FunctionCall AST shape (different rule).
